item.title: Missing Lincoln man, Harrison Schreurs, found dead in Saunders County
item.description: LINCOLN, Neb. (KLKN) — Authorities said a missing Lincoln man was found dead in rural Saunders County on Thursday. Just after 9 a.m., the Lincoln Police Department contacted the Saunders County Sheriff’s Office regarding their missing person case involving 27-year-old Harrison Schreurs. item.title: NU Board of Regents approves Katherine Ankerson as interim chancellor at UNL
item.description: LINCOLN, Neb. (KLKN) — The University of Nebraska Board of Regents on Friday approved the appointment of Katherine Ankerson as interim chancellor for the University of Nebraska-Lincoln. Ankerson takes over the role following the resignation of Rodney Bennett, who served as UNL’s chancellor from mid-2023 until January.
